decisions.statement: A band no Maia weights are held for refuses the call before a move is made.
The side Alan takes is named on the call, and white is taken where none is.
A call naming no position opens from the first rank.
A side naming neither white nor black refuses the call.
A side that answers no move resigns, and the other side wins.
A finished game lands as a page, and the moves land in a file beside that page.
A page is written through the change working out what kind of path it is.
The writing a game goes through is handed in.
A run that played before it threw says in its refusal what that run had done.
No test here runs an engine.

definition: the command playing one game out against the Maia model and writing it down
